tests.description: Ember's Fear rises when the Zombie is near (light turns red, stage goes up), settles slowly when it leaves, rises when the lantern is nearly empty, and calms faster at the Fireplace.
tests.name: Ember fear rises and turns the light red
source: const setAll = (name, val) => { for (const f of harness.getObjects('LanternFlame')) harness.setObjectVariable(f.id, name, val); };
const holdZombie = (dx) => () => { const p = harness.getObjects('Player')[0]; harness.setObjectPosition(zid, p.x + dx, p.y, p.z); };
harness.assert(fear() < 5 && stage() === 0, 'Ember is calm with the monster far away');
await harness.stepFrames(300, { onFrame: () => { holdZombie(250)(); setAll('Strength', 100); maxFear = Math.max(maxFear, fear()); } });
console.log('monster near: fear', fear().toFixed(1), 'max', maxFear.toFixed(1), 'stage', stage(), 'color', color());
harness.assert(fear() > 60 && stage() >= 2, 'Fear rises to Afraid or worse with the monster close');
console.log('4s after monster left: fear', before.toFixed(1), '->', fear().toFixed(1), 'stage', stage());
harness.assert(fear() < before - 15 && fear() > 25, 'Fear settles slowly after the monster leaves');
harness.assert(fear() > 20, 'a nearly empty lantern frightens Ember');
// 5. At the fireplace: calms faster than in the open
harness.setObjectPosition(p.id, fire.centerX - 110 - (p.centerX - p.x), fire.centerY - (p.centerY - p.y), fire.z + 5);
console.log('2s calm drop: open', openDrop.toFixed(1), 'at fire', fireDrop.toFixed(1), 'warmth', harness.getSceneVariable('LanternWarmth').value.toFixed(2));
harness.assert(fireDrop > openDrop * 1.4, 'Ember calms faster at the fireplace');
